runtime_isolation.default_locations: disabled through official Junie CLI flags and environment variables
runtime_isolation.live_home_guard: account ~/.junie metadata must remain unchanged across installer probes and launches
runtime_isolation.launch_lock: target-internal O_NOFOLLOW 0600 lock file is held with fcntl.flock; its parent is 0500 while held and crash-stale files are recovered by flock state
runtime_isolation.pre_child_artifact_revalidation: target-owned Junie shim and pinned Junie binary path, inode, size, and SHA256 are revalidated immediately before child execution
runtime_isolation.verified_path_handoff: launch retains open verified fds as evidence, write-protects verified executable parent chains through child completion, then executes the target-owned path with Popen
runtime_isolation.same_uid_boundary: ordinary unlink/replace is blocked while protected; deliberate same-UID chmod or ancestor tampering is outside this no-sandbox boundary
